description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity. It provides methods to set employee details and retrieve state names related to US tax exemptions, utilizing services to resolve apparently stored state codes to province names.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmpUsTaxExemption entity that provides additional behavior to manage employee association and retrieve state names via country service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpUsTaxExemption entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the tax exemption based on employee number.

methods.name: getTaxState
methods.description: Returns the name of the tax state using the state code stored in the entity.

methods.name: getUnemploymentState
methods.description: Returns the name of the unemployment state using the state code stored in the entity.

methods.name: getWorkState
methods.description: Returns the name of the work state using the state code stored in the entity.
